summary.value: At the start of a conflict scene, perform the Inventory action to produce an elemental shard, potion or tool of total IP

system.description: At the start of a conflict scene, perform the Inventory action to produce an elemental shard, potion or tool of total IP cost (SL + 2) or lower — you still pay the IP. Triggers on the Turn when swapping in mid-conflict. Never in the same conflict as the Rogue's High Speed (the Telumorian Vambrace lifts the lock).
